title: Roblox Q2 2026 shareholder letter
publisher: Roblox Corporation via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Q2 bookings grew 8%; Q3 bookings were guided to decline 14% to 18% year over year.
summary: Roblox's SEC-filed Q2 letter reports continued user, revenue and cash-flow growth but weaker per-hour monetization, withdrawal of full-year guidance, expected Q3 bookings contraction and near-zero Q3 free cash flow.
